title: Developer Access + UI Cleanup
summary: Owner development access is now unlimited, the pricing experience is cleaner, and the pointless decorative play card is gone from the core Analyse hero.
discord_changes: Owner developer access now bypasses YTIntel monthly usage limits without requiring a paid Pro subscription.
Removed the decorative play-card graphic from Analyse and Packaging so the core workflow stays focused.
Reworked the Pro modal into a calmer, cleaner product surface and removed the internal Stripe setup warning from the customer-facing experience.
changes: Added a server-side developer/admin unlimited-access path to commercial status and usage consumption.
Granted the active owner account permanent admin/developer access with no subscription expiry.
Added a DEV · Unlimited full access state in the YTIntel header and hides upgrade prompts for developer accounts.
Removed the faux play-button hero decoration and restored the full text width in Analyse and Packaging.
Simplified pricing typography, spacing, colors, card hierarchy and mobile ordering.
Replaced the technical Stripe business-name blocker copy with a clean checkout-coming-soon state.
Bumped the PWA shell to v0.29.2 so the polish loads cleanly across existing installs.
why_it_matters: The owner should never be blocked by the product's customer billing limits, and the first-screen UI should explain the workflow rather than decorate it. This release makes both true.
